objectives.en: Say every fact from five times one to five times twelve without help.
objectives.yo: Sọ gbogbo fact láti five times one dé five times twelve láìsí ìrànlọ́wọ́.
objectives.pcm: Talk every fact from five times one reach five times twelve without help.

objectives.en: Answer any five times fact out of order.
objectives.yo: Dáhùn èyíkéyìí five times fact láìtẹ̀lé ètò.
objectives.pcm: Answer any five times fact wey no follow order.

curriculum.objective: Multiply whole numbers 1 x 1 up to 9 x 9, using a 10 by 10 square chart
curriculum.note: No scheme subdivides the 1x1 to 9x9 block by table; only the term is supported.

say.en: Look at three groups of five mangoes. Today we count in fives.
say.pcm: Look three groups of five mango. Today we go count five five.
say.yo: Wo groups three ti five mango. Lónìí a ó kà ní five five.

say.en: Today you will learn the five times table. Then you will say it by yourself.
say.pcm: Today you go learn table five. Then you go talk am by yourself.
say.yo: Lónìí ìwọ yóò kọ́ table five. Lẹ́yìn náà, ìwọ yóò sọ ọ́ fúnra rẹ.

say.en: Do you remember the four times table? What is four times five?
say.pcm: You remember table four? Four times five na how much?
say.yo: Ṣé o rántí table four? Kí ni four times five?

say.en: Three groups of five mangoes show this. We count five, ten, fifteen. Five times three is fifteen.
say.pcm: See three groups of five mango: five, ten, fifteen. Five times three na fifteen.
say.yo: Wo groups mẹ́ta ti five mango: five, ten, fifteen. Five times three jẹ́ fifteen.

say.en: Say it with me: five times three is fifteen.
say.pcm: Say am with me: five times three na fifteen.
say.yo: Sọ ọ́ pọ̀ mọ́ mi: five times three jẹ́ fifteen.

say.en: Say the five times table. Start with five times one. End with five times twelve.
say.pcm: Say table five. Start with five times one. End with five times twelve.
say.yo: Sọ table five. Bẹ̀rẹ̀ pẹ̀lú five times one. Parí pẹ̀lú five times twelve.

say.en: Let us fix the ones you missed. Listen, then say them with me.
say.pcm: Make we fix the ones you miss. Hear them, then say them with me.
say.yo: Jẹ́ ká tún àwọn tí o pàdánù ṣe. Gbọ́, lẹ́yìn náà sọ wọ́n pọ̀ mọ́ mi.

say.pcm: Five times seven na how much?

say.en: Well done. Tomorrow we check the five times table once more. Then we start the six times table.
say.pcm: You do well. Tomorrow we go check table five again. Then we start table six.
say.yo: O ṣe dáadáa. Lọ́la a ó tún ṣàyẹ̀wò table five. Lẹ́yìn náà a ó bẹ̀rẹ̀ table six.
